Every production AI system whether it's powering customer support writing code analyzing financial data or diagnosing medical conditions; needs the same foundational infrastructure A way to route between models A way to manage tools and integrate them securely A way to orchestrate agents and enforce governance A unified compute layer to run it all
That infrastructure layer is being built right now

We're TrueFoundry and we're building it

title: iOS Developer
jobDescription:
Osmos, a B2B SaaS company founded by ex-Amazon ad-tech experts, is revolutionizing retail media with an AI-powered operating system that increases retailer profitability (by up to 7% of sales) and delivers superior ROAS for brands. By enabling Tier 1 retailers and marketplaces worldwide to activate more brands and leverage advanced targeting, we help them secure a lasting competitive edge.

Your Impact: We are seeking a highly motivated iOS Developer to join our team. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and maintain high-quality mobile applications that deliver seamless and engaging user experiences.

Job Summary

Osmos seeking a highly motivated iOS Developer to join our team. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and maintain high-quality mobile applications that deliver seamless and engaging user experiences.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain high-performance mobile applications and Ads SDKs across iOS, and Flutter platforms
  • Take ownership of SDK development, integration, and optimization for client applications
  • Collaborate with product managers, backend engineers, and designers to define and implement scalable mobile solutions
  • Build reusable, modular, and maintainable code for both apps and SDK components
  • Ensure seamless integration with backend services via REST/GraphQL APIs
  • Optimize app and SDK performance (latency, memory usage, battery consumption, app size)
  • Debug and resolve complex issues including crashes, ANRs, and integration failures
  • Ensure consistent behavior and UI/UX across platforms and devices
  • Implement best practices for mobile security, data handling, and versioning
  • Manage app releases on Play Store and App Store and handle rollout strategies
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines for automated builds, testing, and releases
  • Monitor production performance (crashes, usage, SDK impact) and continuously improve reliability
  • Stay updated with evolving mobile technologies and propose improvements

You'll Thrive If You Have

  • 1-3 years of experience in iOS application development
  • Strong working knowledge of Swift and the iOS SDK
  • Hands-on experience with UIKit and/or SwiftUI
  • Basic understanding of iOS application architecture, such as MVC/MVVM
  • Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, networking, and asynchronous programming
  • Understanding of iOS app lifecycle, threading, and memory management (ARC)
  • Experience with Git and version control
  • Experience debugging crashes, UI issues, memory problems, and performance issues
  • Familiarity with tools such as Xcode Debugger, Instruments, and Firebase Crashlytics
  • Understanding of different iOS versions, screen sizes, and device compatibility
  • Basic understanding of unit testing and UI testing using XCTest/XCUITest
  • Exposure to third-party SDK integration; Ads SDK experience is a plus
  • Basic understanding of iOS app release and deployment using TestFlight/App Store
  • Ability to write clean, readable, and maintainable code
  • Strong debugging, problem-solving, and learning skills
  • Ability to take ownership of assigned features from development through testing and release
  • Good communication and collaboration skills with product, QA, backend, and engineering teams

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Ads/Monetization SDKs (video ads, display ads, programmatic)
  • Experience with WebView, hybrid apps, or JS bridges
  • Knowledge of Firebase, crash analytics, or performance monitoring tools
  • Published apps or SDKs on Play Store/App Store
  • Experience with offline support, caching, and low-network optimization

The Implementation Analyst I role is responsible for developing, configuring, testing, and supporting chatbot and workflow automation solutions using low-code platforms. The role focuses on implementing business requirements through chatbot development, workflow automation, and API integrations while ensuring solution quality and adherence to best practices.

The ideal candidate should possess a strong mix of:

  • Chatbot and workflow development
  • Low-code platform knowledge (Chatlayer, Node-RED or similar)
  • API integration and troubleshooting
  • Problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Learning mindset and technical curiosity

Chatbot & Workflow Development

  • Design and develop automation workflows and chatbot solutions using Chatlayer, Node-RED, or similar low-code platforms.
  • Configure, develop, test, and deploy chatbot solutions based on business requirements.
  • Implement conversational flows, business logic, and workflow automation.
  • Support enhancements and maintenance of existing chatbot implementations.

Automation & Integration

  • Develop and integrate chatbot workflows with REST (JSON) and SOAP APIs.
  • Configure third-party system integrations using APIs.

  • Exposure to enterprise application integrations will be an added advantage.

  • Containers: Docker and Kubernetes in production environments.

  • ArgoCD, Helm, or Istio - GitOps and service mesh exposure.

  • Golang

descriptionFromApi:
Job Summary

Every deal Hevo closes in the US starts somewhere: a webinar someone registered for, a booth conversation at a trade show, a case study that made a prospect say "we need this," a LinkedIn post from one of our execs that got shared around a buying committee. Youll be the person who makes all of that happen, reliably, every single week.

We already have the playbooks. Our webinar and field event programs are proven and consistently driving pipeline. Were ready to take these programs further, and we need someone to own that growth day-to-day. Thats where you come in: own four high-impact programs end-to-end, ship consistently, and watch your fingerprints show up in the pipeline numbers every month.

What Youll Do

A. Webinar Event Execution

  • Run monthly webinar promo cycles end-to-end (email, LinkedIn, partner, and BDR outreach) with accurate registration tracking and CRM campaign association.
  • Plan and execute in-person field events (trade shows, roundtables, meetups, partner events): build pre-event lists and outreach, schedule meetings, and manage all logistics and on-site ops.
  • Drive post-event follow-up sequences and ensure clean CRM uploads, so attendees convert into pipeline rather than just a headcount.

B. Customer Stories Executive Thought Leadership

  • Schedule and run case-study interviews with Account Managers/TAMs and customers.
  • Draft the case study, hand off to Design, chase approvals to closure, and publish it out into the world.
  • Turn our execs ideas and talking points into LinkedIn content that sounds like them: draft and repurpose thought-leadership posts and threads across multiple exec voices and accounts.
  • Own the posting cadence and keep the content pipeline consistently full.

C. Reporting

  • Track and report on registrations, attendance, content shipped, and pipeline/conversion impact across all four programs.
  • Use this data to flag capacity constraints or execution gaps back to your manager.

What You Bring

  • 1-3 years of experience in field marketing, event marketing, or event management, ideally with some exposure to how events tie into pipeline/revenue, not just attendance.
  • Working knowledge of the event marketing lifecycle (pre/during/post), including sponsorships vs. field motion, booth ops, and dinners, and an understanding that follow-up is where pipeline is actually won.
  • Comfort orchestrating multi-channel promotion (email, LinkedIn, partner, BDR outreach) to fill a US-based event or webinar. Prior experience marketing to a US audience is a strong plus.
  • Strong copywriting and drafting skills: you can turn a rough brief into clean, on-message copy with minimal edits, and adapt to different voices (useful for the case study and thought-leadership work).
  • High execution rigour: you hit recurring deadlines without needing to be chased.
  • Assertiveness: you chase approvals, vendors, and internal stakeholders to closure on your own.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently as well as part of a cross-functional team, coordinating with AMs/TAMs, Design, BDRs, partners, and senior execs.

Why This Role

You wont be one of ten people quietly maintaining a program. Youll personally own four of Hevos sharpest pipeline-generating motions in the US market, with a direct line of sight from what you ship to what closes. If youre excited by fast execution, tight ownership, and watching your work move real numbers, this is that role.

This role is also built to grow. Youll start as the execution owner across all four programs, working off documented playbooks. As you build a track record, theres room to move into owning program strategy and targets directly, and beyond that, into a broader marketing programs/demand-gen ownership track.

  • Support the planning, coordination and execution of deployments across Development, Test, UAT and Production environments.
  • Manage Power Platform solution packaging and deployment using established release processes.

AI Engineer - Customer Success Services (F5)

Location: Hybrid (Hyderabad)

Why this role matters

As F5 scales its SaaS and subscription offerings, intelligent automation and AI-driven experiences across support and success workflows are mission-critical. The AI Engineer will design, build, and operate the core ML/AI systems that power self-service, agent assist, knowledge automation, routing, summarization, and safety/observability tooling, delivering measurable improvements in CSAT, deflection, MTTR and agent productivity.

Position summary

You will lead the technical vision and delivery for AI systems across the Customer Success Support portfolio (myF5, case management, knowledge, omni-channel). You'll translate product needs into robust machine learning architectures, own model lifecycle and MLOps, implement safe RAG/LLM systems and observability, and partner closely with Product, Support Ops, Security/Compliance, and external vendor platforms to ship production-grade solutions. You are both a hands-on engineer able to deliver production code and an influencer who mentors engineers and sets engineering standards.

  • Define technical architecture and roadmap for AI capabilities in support workflows: retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), LLM-based assistants, intent classification, summarization, knowledge generation/maintenance, and conversational systems.

  • Cloud Services: Implement and maintain cloud-native applications on Azure or AWS, leveraging managed services such as computing, networking, databases (e.g., Postgres, DynamoDB, Cosmos DB), and object storage (e.g., S3, Azure Blob).
  • Proficient in implementing robust testing strategies for Java applications using frameworks such as JUnit, TestNG, Mockito, Selenium, and Cucumber.
  • Event-Driven Architecture: Design and implement event-driven systems using tools such as Solace, Kafka, or AWS SNS/SQS, ensuring real-time communication and asynchronous workflows.
  • DevOps CI/CD: Create and maintain CI/CD pipelines with tools like GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins, streamlining deployment processes.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Utilize IaC tools like Terraform, ARM, or Bicep to manage cloud configurations and provision reliable infrastructure.
  • Containerization Orchestration: Develop and deploy scalable containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes (e.g., AKS/EKS).
  • Integrate AI components with platform systems (Salesforce Service Cloud / Experience Cloud, myF5 portal, search engines like Coveo), and with Azure/AWS cloud services and data platforms.
  • Instrument KPIs and observability for AI features (deflection rate, CSAT impact, SLA compliance, model accuracy, latency, drift); use metrics to drive iterations.
  • Prototype, experiment, and evaluate new models and approaches; maintain a research product mindset to bring practical, timely AI to production.
  • Coach and mentor engineers and data scientists; set best practices for reproducible experiments, feature engineering, model tests, and CI/CD for models.

jobDescription:
Job Purpose
As an AI Engineer in Data Intelligence Unit, you will help build and operate the core building blocks of Data Representation learning and Context Engineering across the credit Risk, Fraud/FRM, Sales, Collections Recovery. You will work with senior engineers and Data scientists to converts raw structured and unstructured data into reliable features, embeddings, retrieval-ready knowledge assets, and repeatable evaluation pipelines so downstream AI pods can ship models faster, safer, and with measurable quality.
Duties and Responsibilities
1) Data Representation Pipelines

Prepare and validate datasets from multiple sources (transactions, bureau, device/digital, documents,

CRM/operations)


Implement features engineering pipelines (aggregations, ratios, behavior signals) and maintain feature

definitions.


Build large-scale ML systems: distributed training pipelines, feature stores, model registry, CI/CD for ML, and

scalable batch + near-real-time scoring services.


Support embedding workflows (text/customer/device/dealer/geo) including batch refresh, versioning, and

lineage.


2) Knowledge Engineering Support (Canonical Objects Metadata Assets)

Help create/maintain canonical objects, entity dictionaries, taxonomies/ontologies, and labeling guidelines.

Support annotation/labeling workflows (quality checks, consistency, sampling) for training and evaluation.


3) Experimentation Model Operations

Execute training/inference jobs using established frameworks, log experiments and outcomes.

Perform error analysis, data leakage checks, and basic model monitoring (drift signals, data anomalies)

Contribute to deployment readiness: tests, reproducible configs, and incident triage support.


4) Retrieval Context Engineering Support (LLM/RAG enablement)

Assist document processing: chunking, cleaning, metadata tagging, indexing access filters.

Maintain prompt/context templates, grounding rules, and evaluation sets for RAG/LLM assistants used by

Pods.

Run offline evaluations (retrieval quality, answer quality, regressions) and track metrics across releases.

5) Engineering Hygiene Governance

Write clean, testable code; follow Git workflows and CI checks.

Maintain documentation: dataset cards, feature notes, pipeline SOPs, and release checklists.

Follow security/privacy controls for regulated data, ensuring traceability and auditability.

Bachelors/Masters in CS/Math/Engineering

production grade ML system at scale.

ML Fundamentals: supervised/unsupervised learning, embeddings, train/val/test discipline, metrics, and error analysis. You will work with senior engineers and Data scientists to converts raw structured and unstructured data into reliable features, embeddings, retrieval-ready knowledge assets, and repeatable evaluation pipelines so downstream AI pods can ship models faster, safer, and with measurable quality.
Duties and Responsibilities
1) Data Representation Pipelines

Prepare and validate datasets from multiple sources (transactions, bureau, device/digital, documents,

CRM/operations)


Implement features engineering pipelines (aggregations, ratios, behavior signals) and maintain feature

definitions.


Build large-scale ML systems: distributed training pipelines, feature stores, model registry, CI/CD for ML, and

scalable batch + near-real-time scoring services.


Support embedding workflows (text/customer/device/dealer/geo) including batch refresh, versioning, and

lineage.


2) Knowledge Engineering Support (Canonical Objects Metadata Assets)

Help create/maintain canonical objects, entity dictionaries, taxonomies/ontologies, and labeling guidelines.

Support annotation/labeling workflows (quality checks, consistency, sampling) for training and evaluation.


3) Experimentation Model Operations

Execute training/inference jobs using established frameworks, log experiments and outcomes.

Perform error analysis, data leakage checks, and basic model monitoring (drift signals, data anomalies)

Contribute to deployment readiness: tests, reproducible configs, and incident triage support.


4) Retrieval Context Engineering Support (LLM/RAG enablement)

Assist document processing: chunking, cleaning, metadata tagging, indexing access filters.

Maintain prompt/context templates, grounding rules, and evaluation sets for RAG/LLM assistants used by

Pods.

Run offline evaluations (retrieval quality, answer quality, regressions) and track metrics across releases.

5) Engineering Hygiene Governance

Write clean, testable code; follow Git workflows and CI checks.

Maintain documentation: dataset cards, feature notes, pipeline SOPs, and release checklists.

Follow security/privacy controls for regulated data, ensuring traceability and auditability.

  • Participate in on-call rotations to support business operations, including off-hours.
  • Support and optimize ML model deployment pipelines and monitoring systems.
  • Assist in automating routine tasks and processes to reduce human errors.

Role Purpose:

The Service Desk Agent (SDA) serves as the first point of contact for information technology (IT) support needs, delivering responsive, consistent, reliable, and customer focused assistance to ensure the smooth operation of day-to-day activities.As the role evolves toward an enhanced customer experience, and as the face and voice for users seeking aid, the role holder represents the service experience and is essential in building trust.This role is key to diagnosing and resolving incidents, providing user guidance and handling service requests.

  • Technical capabilityAbility to support standard technical queries related to a focused range of hardware and software products, capable of using and configuring computer systems to troubleshoot and resolve issues.

Listens actively, communicates with clarity, and takes full ownership of the customers needs by not just resolving issues, but ensuring they feel heard and valued. Understands that every interaction shapes the customers perception of Fujitsu, and strives to turn challenges into positive experiences.
  • InnovationEmbraces change and drives progress by actively seeking and applying smarter, faster, and more efficient ways to deliver support. Recognizes the importance of staying informed about technological trends and continuously developing skills. Leverages emerging technologies such as automation, AI, and digital tools to streamline workflows and enhance the customer experience. Thinks creatively to solve problems, challenges the status quo, and contributes with fresh ideas that will help shaping the future of the service desk. Fosters a mindset of ongoing experimentation and learning to adapt to change, anticipate future needs, and consistently deliver impactful and forward-thinking support.
  • Business awarenessClear understanding of the customer''s business environment, priorities, and service expectations to ensure the delivery of high-quality and value-driven support. Aligns IT actions with business impact, enabling proactive and customer-centric service.
  • ProcessFollows and suggests improvements for established service desk processes and tools to ensure consistent and efficient support delivery. Understands the extreme importance of accurately recording all relevant information and actions on the tickets, and any other relevant actions or tasks performed by the role holder on a daily basis. Avoids ticket duplication, promotes knowledge sharing, aligns with account procedures and security policies to maintain service quality.
  • Problem solvingTakes ownership of understanding and resolving customer issues within required timescales by actively listening and asking relevant questions. Escalates complex issues appropriately, ensuring timely resolution while continuously developing technical knowledge and diagnostic skills for evolving support scenarios.
  • Security awarenessUnderstands the critical role of security in daily service desk operations and recognizes that security related incidents are frequent and evolving. Follows established security policies and procedures, remains alert to common threats, and takes proactive steps to safeguard customer and company information. Embraces feedback and lessons learned to drive ongoing optimization, making sure the support keeps up with changing customer and business needs. Adheres to existing internal activities, such as Kojo and CommCells, to actively promote and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement.

ABOUT AMGEN
Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the worlds toughest diseases, and make peoples lives easier, fuller and longer. This role sits at the intersection of medicinal chemistry, computational science, with a focus on developing and applying AI-enabled workflows that accelerate molecular design, scientific data interpretation, and research decision-making.
The ideal candidate will hold a Masters degree in Chemistry or a related discipline, bring a strong scientific foundation, and preferably have relevant pharmaceutical, biotechnology, CRO, or other industry research experience. A PhD is not required.
Responsibilities

  • Organize, curate, and assess chemical, biological, and assay data to support reliable AI-enabled analysis and decision-making.
  • Evaluate AI-generated outputs for scientific validity, relevance, reproducibility, and practical value in discovery chemistry programs.
  • Translate scientific questions and laboratory needs into structured workflows, prompts, evaluation approaches, and usable tools.
  • Support adoption of agentic AI tools within discovery chemistry teams while maintaining rigorous standards for data integrity, documentation, confidentiality, and scientific quality.
  • Work with laboratory scientists to incorporate experimental results and user feedback into iterative workflow and tool improvements.
  • Contribute to the development of best practices for the appropriate use of generative AI and agentic systems in research.
  • Stay current with advances in AI, cheminformatics, laboratory automation, and computational drug discovery.
  • Communicate results, workflow performance, and recommendations clearly to cross-functional scientific stakeholders.
Basic Qualifications
  • Masters degree in Chemistry, Medicinal Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemical Biology, Computational Chemistry, Data Science, or a closely related scientific field.
  • Strong understanding of small-molecule discovery, organic synthesis, medicinal chemistry, analytical chemistry, or an allied area.
  • Experience working with scientific data, including chemical structures, reaction data, assay data, or experimental results.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze problems systematically, document work clearly, and maintain high standards of scientific rigor.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, cross-functional research environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Prior industry experience in pharmaceutical R&D, biotechnology, CROs, chemical research, medicinal chemistry, discovery chemistry, or a related setting.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML tools, large language models, generative AI, agentic workflows, or data-driven approaches for scientific research.
  • Experience with cheminformatics, chemical databases, molecular representations, or structure and reaction data.
  • Familiarity with tools or concepts such as SMILES, SDF, RDKit, electronic laboratory notebooks, reaction informatics, generative AI in chemistry and computational quantum chemistry.
  • Experience assessing computational, AI, or software-generated recommendations against experimental evidence or scientific criteria.
  • Ability to learn new technologies quickly and apply them thoughtfully to real-world discovery chemistry problems.
Preferred Experience:
  • Bachelor''s with 59 years of experience.

About the Role

  • You sit at the intersection of Visual Effects (VFX), Game Engines, and Generative AI.
  • You will be responsible for creating hyper-realistic, cinematic video content by blending traditional compositing tools with state-of-the-art AI platforms.
  • We don't just want "AI videos"we want production-grade realism.
  • You must understand lighting, camera movement, and consistency, using AI as a power tool to accelerate high-end workflows.

Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Creation: Conceptualize and produce high-fidelity video content using a hybrid workflow of AI generation and manual VFX polishing.
  • Advanced AI Prompting: Utilize tools like Runway (Gen-3), Kling, Midjourney, and Sora/Veo to generate base assets with precise camera control and character consistency.
  • VFX & Compositing: Take AI-generated raw footage and refine it using After Effects, Nuke, or DaVinci Resolve.
  • Fix artifacts, handle color grading, and ensure temporal stability (no "flickering").
  • 3D & Gaming Integration: Work with Unreal Engine 5 or Blender to create realistic environments and integrate digital avatars if required.
  • Character Consistency: Train or fine-tune models (LoRAs/ControlNet) to ensure characters look exactly the same across different shots and angles.
  • R&D: Stay updated daily on the newest AI tools.
  • If a new model drops on Hugging Face or GitHub, you should be the first to test it.

Required Skills & Toolset 1.

  • The "Real" Tech Stack (Non-Negotiable): VFX/Editing: Mastery of Adobe After Effects (Compositing, Roto), Premiere Pro, and DaVinci Resolve (Color Grading).
  • 3D Basics: Familiarity with Blender or Unreal Engine (Camera setting, Lighting, Environment design).
  • The AI Stack (Deep Knowledge Required): Video Gen: Runway Gen-3 Alpha, Kling AI, Luma Dream Machine, or Haiper.
  • Image Gen: Midjourney v6 (Advanced Parameters), Stable Diffusion (ComfyUI workflows are a huge plus).
  • Lip-Sync & Voice: ElevenLabs, HeyGen, or LivePortrait.
  • Optimization: Topaz Video AI (Upscaling) and interpolation tools.
  • Soft Skills: "Director's Eye": You understand cinematographyfocal lengths, shutter angles, lighting setups (Rim light, Key light), and composition.
  • Problem Solving: AI makes mistakes.
  • You must know how to fix "weird hands" or "glitchy eyes" manually in post-production.

Nice-to-Have (Bonus Points)

  • Experience in the Gaming Industry (Level Design, Cinematics, or Character Rigging).
  • Knowledge of ComfyUI Node systems for complex Stable Diffusion workflows.
  • Experience with Python scripting for automating media workflows.
  • Background in traditional art or photography.
  • Who You Are You don't just type "Make a cool video" into ChatGPT.
  • You write detailed prompts like "Cinematic wide shot, 35mm lens, volumetric lighting, cyberpunk street, unreal engine 5 render style --ar 16:9".
  • You are frustrated when AI video looks "wobbly" and you know exactly how to stabilize it.
  • You have an open mindset: You are willing to relearn your workflow every month as technology changes.
  • Submission Requirement Please do not send just a CV.
  • You must share a Portfolio or Showreel demonstrating: AI-Generated Video work (mentioning the tools used).
  • Any VFX breakdowns (Before/After) showing how you fixed/improved raw AI output.
